summary: Tested admin students page new filters + CSV export (iteration 18). All 10 backend pytest cases pass. Frontend filter bar, multi-select course filter (OR logic), reset, matched badges, CSV download, and student detail dialog all work. One minor mobile overflow issue found at 390px.

minor.issue: No DELETE endpoint for removing a student (admin can't delete students). Not required by this task but affects test cleanup -- TEST_filter_* seed users remain in DB after test run.

issues: Filter bar causes horizontal page overflow (document.scrollWidth=419 vs 390). Date inputs + Kurslar dropdown on same row push total beyond viewport. Consider wrapping date range row or shrinking date input width <150px on mobile.

action_items: Fix mobile 390px horizontal overflow in filter bar on /yonetim/ogrenciler (allow date-row to wrap or reduce date Input widths below sm breakpoint).
Note: review_request references route '/admin/students' but actual admin route is '/yonetim/ogrenciler' (Turkish LMS). Routes work correctly; just a naming mismatch in the request.
critical_code_review_comments: _student_query end_date handling: when 10-char YYYY-MM-DD is given with timezone-aware ISO created_at strings, appending '+00:00' works, but if any user record has local-ISO without tz, string comparison could skip them. Current data is tz-aware so OK.
No DELETE endpoint for admin to remove a student record; relying on manual DB access.
export_students loads up to 20000 rows into memory; acceptable for current scale.

success_rate.frontend: 90% (all core flows pass; mobile overflow is minor)

seed_data_creation: Created TEST_filter_<tag>_0/1@example.com students via /api/auth/register, enrolled student 0 in first course. Cleanup via DELETE /api/admin/enrollments ran, but no DELETE user endpoint, so TEST_ user records remain in db.users. Safe to delete via Mongo: db.users.deleteMany({email: /^test_filter_/i}).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file /app/backend/tests/test_students_filters.py is reusable. Admin route for students is /yonetim/ogrenciler (not /admin/students). To clean up test users left behind: db.users.deleteMany({email: /^test_filter_/i}) in Mongo.
